title: UltraArUco: A Lightweight Multilingual Library And Framework With Low-Latency Real-Time Marker-Based Tracking System For Mobile AR Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2608.13584v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: UltraArUco - a lightweight multilingual library and framework for low-latency, real-time marker-based tracking in mobile augmented reality. Unlike standard OpenCV-based implementations, UltraArUco introduces an optimized multilingual wrapper that reduces per-frame latency by five times, while maintaining high accuracy. Distributed Wi-Fi architecture provides portability, connects a mobile device (camera input) with a PC-based visual application, enabling responsive interactions. The framework is validated through an interactive piano simulation, where static ArUco markers on keys enable occlusion-based note triggering, and hand-mounted markers provide spatial gesture recognition. UltraArUco's system requirements make it perfect for resource-constrained mobile AR applications, demonstrating a viable AR music application without specialized equipment.

translated_title: UltraArUco：一种用于移动AR交互的轻量级多语言库与低延迟实时标记跟踪系统框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13584v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：UltraArUco——一个用于移动增强现实中低延迟、实时标记跟踪的轻量级多语言库和框架。与基于OpenCV的标准实现不同，UltraArUco引入了一个优化的多语言封装，将每帧延迟降低了五倍，同时保持高精度。分布式Wi-Fi架构提供了便携性，将移动设备（摄像头输入）与基于PC的视觉应用程序连接起来，实现响应式交互。该框架通过一个交互式钢琴模拟进行了验证，其中键盘上的静态ArUco标记实现了基于遮挡的音符触发，而手部佩戴的标记则提供了空间手势识别。UltraArUco的系统需求使其非常适合资源受限的移动AR应用，展示了无需专用设备即可实现可行的AR音乐应用。
tldr: 通过优化多语言封装和分布式Wi-Fi架构，UltraArUco将移动AR标记跟踪的每帧延迟降低五倍，并在资源受限设备上实现了无需专用设备的AR音乐交互应用。
en_tdlr: UltraArUco reduces per-frame latency by five times in mobile AR marker tracking via an optimized multilingual wrapper and distributed Wi-Fi architecture, enabling resource-constrained AR music interaction without specialized equipment.
